description.en: Batch compress, resize and convert images. Download individually or as a ZIP.
description.zh-Hant: 批次壓縮、調整尺寸與轉換圖片，可逐張下載或打包為 ZIP。

description.en: Generate QR codes or scan local images and your camera, entirely on your device.
description.zh-Hant: 在裝置上產生二維碼，或使用本機圖片與攝影機掃描。

description.en: Merge, split, arrange and rotate PDFs. Convert images to PDF and PDF pages to images.
description.zh-Hant: 合併、拆分、排序與旋轉 PDF，並在圖片與 PDF 頁面之間轉換。

description.en: Count, clean up and transform text without the busywork.
description.zh-Hant: 計算字數、整理與轉換文字，減少重複操作。

description.en: Write Markdown with a live preview, save drafts and export MD or HTML.
description.zh-Hant: 撰寫 Markdown 並即時預覽、儲存草稿及匯出 MD 或 HTML。

description.en: Compare two texts by line or character and export their differences.
description.zh-Hant: 逐行或逐字元比較兩份文字，並匯出差異。

description.en: Extract English, Chinese and Malay text from images, right on your device.
description.zh-Hant: 直接在裝置上，從圖片擷取英文、中文與馬來文。

description.en: Find your rhythm with a simple, adjustable Pomodoro timer.
description.zh-Hant: 使用簡單且可調整的番茄鐘，找出你的專注節奏。

description.en: Draw original English and Chinese answers, turn another page and revisit your history.
description.zh-Hant: 抽取原創中英文答案、再翻一頁，並重溫你的答案歷史。

description.en: Spin a wheel, draw without repeats or create balanced random groups. Autosave your schemes.
description.zh-Hant: 轉動轉盤、不重複抽取或隨機平均分組，並自動儲存方案。

description.en: Practice English or Chinese typing for 60 seconds, or join the public Ranked leaderboard.
description.zh-Hant: 練習 60 秒中英文打字，或參加公開排行測試。

description.en: Check your screen, keyboard and mouse with temporary tests you control.
description.zh-Hant: 由你控制暫時性的測試，檢查螢幕、鍵盤與滑鼠。

description.en: Measure download, upload, latency and jitter with a full Cloudflare connection test.
description.zh-Hant: 透過完整的 Cloudflare 連線測試，測量下載、上傳、延遲與抖動。

description.en: Pack files into a ZIP, inspect an archive and download checked files locally.
description.zh-Hant: 將檔案打包為 ZIP、檢視壓縮檔，並在本機下載已檢查的檔案。

description.en: Convert colors, build a palette, preview gradients and check text contrast.
description.zh-Hant: 轉換色彩、建立調色板、預覽漸層，並檢查文字對比度。

description.en: Convert everyday units, from temperature and distance to volume and storage.
description.zh-Hant: 換算溫度、距離、體積、儲存容量等日常單位。

description.en: Generate a random password on your device, with the length and characters you choose.
description.zh-Hant: 依你選擇的長度與字元，在裝置上產生隨機密碼。

description.en: World clocks, time-zone conversion, calendar date differences and local countdowns.
description.zh-Hant: 世界時鐘、時區換算、日曆日期差距與本機倒數計時。

description.en: Preview batch names, add numbering and download renamed copies as a ZIP.
description.zh-Hant: 預覽批次檔名、加入編號，並將重新命名的副本下載為 ZIP。

description.en: Record your microphone, trim audio and export MP3 or WAV on your device.
description.zh-Hant: 在裝置上使用麥克風錄音、裁剪音訊，並匯出 MP3 或 WAV。

description.en: Validate and format JSON, preview CSV tables and convert between flat JSON and CSV.
description.zh-Hant: 驗證與格式化 JSON、預覽 CSV 表格，並在平面 JSON 與 CSV 之間轉換。

description.en: Create bilingual learning cards, review mastery and sync private decks across devices.
description.zh-Hant: 建立雙語學習卡、複習掌握程度，並跨裝置同步私人牌組。

description.en: Calculate scientific expressions, fractions and percentages with DEG or RAD angles.
description.zh-Hant: 計算科學運算式、分數與百分比，支援 DEG 或 RAD 角度模式。

description.en: Calculate SHA-256 / SHA-512, compare checksums and find matching selected files.
description.zh-Hant: 計算 SHA-256 / SHA-512、比較檢查碼，並找出相符的所選檔案。

description.en: Edit SRT and WebVTT, shift timing and preview subtitles with your local video.
description.zh-Hant: 編輯 SRT 與 WebVTT、調整時間，並搭配本機影片預覽字幕。

description.en: Plan weekly classes, assignments and exams with private account sync.
description.zh-Hant: 規劃每週課堂、作業與考試，並使用私人帳號同步。

description.en: Draw, connect and sketch ideas on privately synced whiteboards.
description.zh-Hant: 在私密同步的白板上繪圖、連結與勾勒想法。

description.en: Record your screen with optional audio, then preview and download locally.
description.zh-Hant: 錄製螢幕與選用的音訊，並在本機預覽及下載。

description.en: Slide, merge and find a little room for one more tile.
description.zh-Hant: 滑動、合併，為下一塊方塊騰出空間。

description.en: Read the numbers. Trust your flags. Clear a careful path.
description.zh-Hant: 解讀數字、標記地雷，謹慎清出安全路徑。

description.en: One more bite, one less corner. A familiar little challenge.
description.zh-Hant: 多吃一口，少一個轉彎空間。熟悉又耐玩的挑戰。

description.en: A few familiar shapes. A little more attention.
description.zh-Hant: 幾個熟悉圖案，考驗多一點專注。

description.en: A little logic, one number at a time. Notes, hints and three difficulties.
description.zh-Hant: 運用邏輯，一次填入一個數字。提供筆記、提示與三種難度。

description.en: Follow the clues. Fill the squares. Reveal a little pixel picture.
description.zh-Hant: 跟隨線索、填滿格子，揭開像素圖案。

description.en: Find a place for every shape. Fill a line and make a little space.
description.zh-Hant: 為每個形狀找個位置，填滿一行以騰出空間。

description.en: Keep the ball in play. Three stages, three lives, one more bounce.
description.zh-Hant: 讓球持續反彈。三個關卡、三條生命，再接住下一次彈跳。

description.en: Four in a row, a move ahead. Play the computer or share a screen.
description.zh-Hant: 四子連成一線，思考下一步。可與電腦對戰或共用螢幕遊玩。

description.en: A quiet move can turn the board. Play the computer or a friend beside you.
description.zh-Hant: 安靜的一步，也能翻轉棋局。可與電腦或身旁好友對弈。

description.en: Find your stack rhythm. Clear a line, chase forty, hold your next move.
description.zh-Hant: 找到堆疊節奏、消除整行、挑戰四十行，或暫存下一步。

description.en: Invite a friend. Share a rally. A private online room for two.
description.zh-Hant: 邀請好友，一起來回接球。專屬兩人的私人線上房間。

description.en: An automotive showcase built around car culture, visual discovery and detailed specifications.
description.zh-Hant: 以汽車文化、視覺探索與詳細規格為核心的汽車展示網站。

description.en: A C++ coursework project exploring how software can support salon operations.
description.zh-Hant: 以 C++ 課程專案，探索軟體如何支援沙龍營運。

description.en: A collection of visual experiments with local AI and image generation.
description.zh-Hant: 使用本機 AI 與圖像生成，展開一系列視覺實驗。
